description: Redesign document checker page: change theme from amber to green (matching app primary color) and improve layout with responsive 2-column grid for desktop. Current page uses amber colors (bg-amber-600, bg-amber-50) inconsistent with rest of app, and stacks all content vertically even on wide screens.
steps: 1. In frontend/app/document/page.tsx line ~145 (header): Change bg-amber-600 to bg-primary, text remains text-white.
2. Line ~155 (main background): Change min-h-screen bg-amber-50 to min-h-screen bg-gray-50.
3. Line ~164 (button): Change bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 to bg-primary hover:bg-primary-dark.
4. Find all border-amber-200 and change to border-gray-200 (appears in multiple card components).
5. Line ~220 (card backgrounds): Change bg-amber-50 border-amber-200 to bg-gray-50 border-gray-200.
6. In the 'READY — Results' section (starting ~250): Change main container from 'space-y-4' to 'space-y-6' for better spacing.

7. Wrap the summary card and risk flags card in a responsive grid:
...summary card...risk flags card...
. Keep document preview image, overall risk badge, Q&A, and action buttons full-width (outside this grid).
8. Test on desktop (≥768px): summary and risk flags should appear side-by-side. Test on mobile (<768px): should stack vertically.
acceptance_criteria: Document checker page header is green (bg-primary #1B6B3A) not amber
Page background is light gray (bg-gray-50) not amber
All buttons use primary green theme
Risk level indicators (red/yellow/green) remain unchanged - these are semantic colors
On desktop screens (≥768px), summary and risk flags appear side-by-side in 2 columns
On mobile screens (<768px), all content stacks vertically
Spacing between sections is increased to 24px (space-y-6) for better readability
verification: npm run dev and visit /document page
Visual check: header should be green, background light gray
Upload or take a photo of a test document and wait for processing
Once results appear, verify on desktop (resize browser ≥768px): summary text box and risk flags should be side-by-side
Resize browser to mobile width (<768px): summary and risk flags should stack vertically
Check that document image preview, overall risk badge, and Q&A section remain full-width
Verify buttons are green with proper hover states
